BASE OIL SN150

PetroBind supplies Group I Base Oil SN150, a light-viscosity mineral base oil used as a feedstock and blending component across lubricant and industrial oil manufacturing. PetroBind offers this grade as a principal trader and supplier, with availability confirmed against quantity, destination, packing method, and logistics window.

PRODUCT GRADE

SN150

TYPE

Group I Solvent Neutral Base Oil

DOCUMENTATION

COA + PDS on request

TYPICAL SPECIFICATIONS — SN150

Values shown are typical reference ranges, not a commercial guarantee. Test methods are named as references, not certifications. The Certificate of Analysis for the confirmed lot governs.

SPECIFICATION VALUE / RANGE
Kinematic Viscosity at 40 C 40-45 cSt
Kinematic Viscosity at 100 C 6-7.5 cSt
Viscosity Index 90-100
Flash Point (min) 190 C
Pour Point -3 C
Colour (ASTM) 1.5-2.5
Density at 15.6 C 0.864-0.874 g/ml
Total Acid Number (TAN) 0.05 mg KOH/g

PRIMARY APPLICATIONS

General industrial oil formulation, mould oil, transmission fluids, gear oils, metalworking fluids, oil additive blending, hydraulic oils, and transformer oils.

TYPICAL EXPORT PACKAGING

Flexitank at 20 MT net weight, or new steel drums at 190 KG or 200 KG, packed for international maritime transport to your destination port.

INFORMATION REQUIRED

Send these items to sales@petrobindglobal.com so we can address them together in our response and keep the exchange to as few rounds as possible.

FOB, CFR, and CIF pricing requirement

Technical specification sheets and requested grade

MOQ, monthly capacity, and lead time expectation

Preferred payment terms and destination port

Pricing: FOB, CFR, and CIF quoted per RFQ against your destination port and volume. Pricing is market-linked; we aim to be competitive on landed cost.

MOQ, capacity and lead time: confirmed per RFQ based on packing and destination.

Payment terms: TT, LC, or other terms confirmed per order during RFQ review.

Inspection: independent third-party inspection (for example, SGS) can be arranged on request or where the contract requires it.

Note: SN150 does not yet have a dedicated product page live on petrobindglobal.com. Use the contact/RFQ page (this chunk's source URL) to reach the sales team directly for SN150 inquiries.
